The passage describes Ibn Battuta’s visit to Hangzhou during the Yuan (Mongol) Dynasty, when foreign merchants — including Muslims — were allowed to reside in Chinese cities and were treated with respect.  
The question asks about changes under the Ming Dynasty, which followed the Yuan.  
One major shift was the Ming’s more restrictive foreign trade policy, including the establishment of designated maritime trade zones and limiting foreign merchants’ access, which later evolved into the Canton System.  
This matches option (A).  

Final answer: (A)
